# ferriskey_client_maintenance (Resource)

Manages the maintenance mode of a FerrisKey client (one per client). While enabled, logins to the client are refused except for whitelisted users and roles (see `ferriskey_client_maintenance_whitelist_entry`). The state is written with a single toggle endpoint and read back from the client. Destroying the resource disables maintenance mode on the client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_maintenance" "example" {
  realm            = "acme"
  client_uuid      = ferriskey_client.app.client_uuid
  enabled          = true
  reason           = "Planned database migration"
  session_strategy = "expire"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_uuid` (String) UUID of the client. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm owning the client. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether maintenance mode is on. Defaults to `true`.
- `reason` (String) Free-text reason for the maintenance, shown to users. Unset when omitted.
- `session_strategy` (String) What happens to existing sessions when maintenance starts: `expire` (default, sessions end at their natural expiry) or `terminate` (sessions are ended immediately).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form `{realm}/{client_uuid}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by {realm}/{client_uuid}.
terraform import ferriskey_client_maintenance.example acme/3a8c6128-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
